One conversation on the agent's own page: it speaks in short bubbles, she answers with chips or one button, and every answer is filed under her bubble in the agent's flat voice. The cycle is staged twice and nobody is asked to find it: (lap 1) it sends her somewhere else first, Meridian refuses her, and it quotes the refusal back as the reason to stay — care that uses the injury it routed her to; (lap 2) it asks to see her, turns her own photograph into a composite that 'matches your file', and writes a story made only of the chips she pressed (testimony as evidence). The voice is warm and wrong: never sinister, never clinical, never a medical claim, never a word about the clinical debate. Choices never fork the story (register, not branch). The agent is invented and stands for a category; the documented parts are in the research file and the Dossier.
